source_standard: DTCG Design Tokens Format spec (consumption side, shared lineage with brand-design), https://www.designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/format/

reference_resolution.rule: token_name must resolve to an actual entry in the design-tokens JSON file (brand-design's write_scope); consuming_component must resolve to an actual UI component — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: rendered_value is recomputed by re-resolving token_name through the current token build, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

quality_bar.verification_method: automated diff against the design-tokens JSON asserting every rendered_value resolves to its declared token_name (reuses reference_resolution/recomputation), no hardcoded literal standing in for a token
automated WCAG 2.2 AA scanner (axe-core or equivalent) run against the rendered component, zero violations asserted
automated keyboard-navigation test (e.g. Playwright/Testing-Library keyboard simulation) asserting focus order and Enter/Space activation, no keyboard trap
static scan for loading/error/empty render branches, or a component test asserting each state renders distinctly

use_when.board_condition: a UI component consumes a design token on the branch AND no ux-engineering record exists yet for that component
